exposure: Point-of-care (POC) measurement of combined umbilical arterial and venous (CUAV) lactate
cohort: The study included 152 live, singleton neonates delivered at a tertiary care center between June and August 2019.
finding: Point-of-care testing of combined umbilical arterial and venous lactate is reliable and closely correlated with umbilical artery lactate concentrations, suggesting its potential as a screening test for neonatal acidosis.
cross-section timing: At delivery, between June and August 2019
